title: The preimage of an open subscheme is the fibre product
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $V\subseteq Y$ an open subscheme. Then the open subscheme $f^{-1}(V)\subseteq X$, together with its inclusion into $X$ and the restriction $f|_{f^{-1}(V)}:f^{-1}(V)\to V$, is a fibre product $X\times_YV$ [def-pc-fibre-product] of $f$ and the inclusion $V\hookrightarrow Y$.
